title: Searching for a UFO that landed and sank in Norway

tellings.quote:
I mean, you know, we looked for one in
Norway.
>> Yeah, we did.
>> Witnesses, I mean, it landed and it
sank.

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, says that he and a guest once went to Norway to look for a UFO that witnesses said had landed and then sunk into the water. He mentions it in passing, and if true it would mean a craft might still lie hidden there.
